name: Koen Bok
current_role: Co-founder and co-CEO, Framer (Amsterdam); co-runs the angel fund Festina
profile: Dutch designer-engineer who co-founded Sofa with Jorn van Dijk, an Amsterdam studio whose Mac apps won two Apple Design Awards and which Facebook acquired in 2011. After working as a product designer at Facebook (messages, ads, video), he co-founded Framer in 2014. Framer grew from a prototyping tool into an AI website-building platform, valued at $2B after a $100M Series D.
interesting_fact: Framer began as a tool to let designers animate and test interactions. It later rebuilt itself into a full website builder and now has AI agents that design, write and build on the canvas.
deep_cut_fact: He calls himself 'half designer, half programmer and a little bit of an entrepreneur'. With Jorn van Dijk he runs Festina, a fund backing startups with world-class UX design.
notes: His personal site invites startup founders to 'drop me a line', but no email is published. Framer lists no press email (only support@ and abuse@). Very approachable for design and startup topics.

name: Adam Richard Dawson

name: Raviteja Dodda
profile: IIT Kharagpur alumnus who co-founded MoEngage in 2014 with fellow KGP alumnus Yashwanth Kumar. MoEngage is an insights-led customer engagement platform used by marketers in 39+ countries, with about 10 offices, and is valued at about $1B.
interesting_fact: MoEngage was founded in 2014 by two IIT Kharagpur alumni, Dodda (CEO) and Yashwanth Kumar (CTO and CISO), and runs marketing automation for brands worldwide.
deep_cut_fact: His productivity stack includes 10xGoals for tracking company-wide quarterly OKRs and Apple Notes for meeting action items. He calls Slack MoEngage's 'Searchable Logs of Communication and Knowledge' and avoids internal email and meetings where Slack will do.
notes: No published press email found on MoEngage's press center. Speaks in Middle East and SEA trade media (Campaign ME, TechCollective).

name: Peter De Caluwe
current_role: Co-founder of Thunes (Singapore); listed by Wikipedia as CEO (verify current title)
profile: Co-founder and long-time CEO of Thunes, the Singapore cross-border payments network spun out of mobile-payments firm TransferTo in 2016. Thunes connects to 4B mobile and stablecoin wallets, 8B bank accounts and 15B cards in about 140 countries, and has been backed by Helios, Checkout.com, GGV, Marshall Wace, Apis and Vitruvian.
interesting_fact: Thunes was born when TransferTo split in 2016: DT One kept mobile top-ups, while Thunes took the cross-border payments business and became a fintech unicorn.

public_contacts.value: https://www.thunes.com/ (company; Press Centre linked in footer)

notes: Thunes may have appointed a new CEO recently; confirm his current title before outreach. The Thunes press-centre page blocks automated access, so no press email was captured. Web search budget ran out.
